title: Jon Ballis – In the Room Where Private Equity Happens at Kirkland & Ellis (Capital Allocators, EP.277)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Jon Ballis is the Chairman of the Executive Committee of Kirkland & Ellis.
reader_summary.overview: Jon Ballis is the Chairman of the Executive Committee of Kirkland & Ellis, one of the world's leading law firms and the market leader in private equity. Kirkland generated $6 billion in revenue last year, including work with 700 investment fund clients and $443 billion in M&A deals across 1,000 transactions.

key_points.text: Jon has been recognized in every edition of the Best Lawyers in America since 2006 and one of the top private equity lawyers by Private Equity Magazine..
Our conversation offers a different angle on what it takes to grow and manage a high-performance professional services firm.
We cover Jon's background and path to Kirkland, growth alongside private equity, oversight of Kirkland's business model for attracting, compensating, and motivating talent.
